title: Unbounded Farming (Rebaked)
description: This mod adds food items to the game, even some unusual ones.
body:
## Welcome to Unbounded Farming (Rebaked)
[image will be added later when made]

{Version 0.0.3 is the most recent version}

This mod adds more food to the game related to mobs and blocks of the wild, allowing you to chef up things you'd usually never be-able to try, such as Eyeblossoms, Nether Warts and the Fungi from the nether, along with adding new additions throughout the world such as Wild Nether Warts.

Do you get bored of the same old food items and also having to download over 15 mods just to get a good selection of food? well then this mod may be for you as each update adds more food to the game which in turn adds more options for consumables along with new blocks!

[Disclaimer: there's not actually a ton of additions in this mod just yet]

#### Things to know about this mod
This mod can probably be used on Servers due to its currently simple nature.

## Additions in this mod:

### Workstations
- Oak Cutting Board
- Brick Cooking Pot

#### Natural

### Foliage
- Wild Nether Wart
- Stripped Crimson Fungus
- Stripped Warped Fungus

### Crops
- Twisted Wart (crop)
- Sweet Potato (crop)
- Sugar Beet (crop)
- Purple Top Turnip (crop)
- Oaxacan Green Dent Corn (crop)
- Leek (crop)

This mod is all about cooking everything possible, each update will be themed around one thing only, for example... an update could be themed around a specific nether biome, getting all the possibilities of food from that particular biome.

[Note: This mod is still under development and some things may be added, changed or altered]
